howItWorks.step2Desc: When a Yape or transfer arrives, forward the screenshot to Mercurio’s WhatsApp. Optionally type a short name like “apt101” to assign it instantly.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Have another question? Message us on WhatsApp or email hello@mercuriohub.io.
faq.q1: How do I track rent payments when my tenants pay by Yape?
faq.a1: You add each tenant in Mercurio with their amount and due day. Whenever you receive a Yape, Plin or transfer, you forward the screenshot on WhatsApp. Mercurio reads the receipt, assigns it to the tenant and updates their status: paid, due soon or late.
faq.q2: Do my tenants need to install anything or sign up?
faq.a2: No. They pay as usual. Only you use Mercurio, by forwarding the receipts you already get.
faq.a3: Screenshots from Yape, Plin (BBVA, Interbank and Scotiabank), BCP transfers and Binance, as images or PDFs. You can send them on WhatsApp or upload them in the dashboard.
faq.q4: What if the receipt doesn’t show the tenant’s name?
faq.a4: When you forward it, type the short name you set for that payment, for example “apt101”, and Mercurio assigns it there. If a payment stays unassigned, you assign it in one click from the dashboard.
faq.q5: Does it work for weekly payments or other businesses?
faq.a5: Yes. Each payment can be weekly, monthly or one-off. Beyond rent, it works for any recurring payment: classes, school fees, memberships or instalments.
faq.q6: Do I need a credit card to start?
faq.a6: No. The Free plan never expires and needs no card. You only pay if you move to Pro, for S/29 a month. Payments are processed by Culqi and you can cancel at any time.
faq.a7: Each account’s data is isolated. Data is encrypted in transit and stored encrypted on AWS servers. We don’t share or sell your data.
faq.q8: Can I move my payments to Excel or Google Sheets?
faq.a8: Yes. Connect your Google account and export your payments to Google Sheets. From there you can download them as Excel.
